name: Nighthawk Memory
description: Hippocampus long-term memory over MCP: recall before each prompt, retain after each turn

token.description: Tenant MCP token (<tenant>.<hmac>), sent as a bearer. Or set NIGHTHAWK_MCP_TOKEN.

agentId.description: Sent as X-Agent-ID; memory records this agent as the speaker.

bank.description: A label only: memory is one bank per agent, named by agentId.
